Turn your ideas into stunning 3D models — right in your browser.

Whether you're a student doing a school project, a 3D printing enthusiast crafting your next masterpiece, or a hobbyist game developer building worlds, our intuitive 3D modeling app is built for you.

Model by Jeroen. Touch to interact!

The What and the Why

Figuro is a polygonal modeling app. With an extensive set of 3D tools, you can create stunning 3D models and fine-tune their polygons, edges, vertices and uv's with precision.

High-end 3D modeling apps like Blender might feel overwhelming, while simpler tools like Tinkercad may lack the advanced features you need. We build Figuro to fit right in the middle.

Designed for both beginners and advanced users, Figuro offers helpful videos, downloadable models in our gallery and tutorials in the Designer itself. You'll be up and running in no time!

3D MODELING TOOLS
- Bevel

Bevel polygons or edges using the gizmo and dragging the mouse.

- Colorize

Assign a color to objects or polygons.

- Connect

Connect polygons, edges or vertices.

- Dematerialize

Remove materials from objects or individual polygons.

- Extract

Extracts polygons from objects, creating new objects with them.

- Extrude

Push/pull polygons or edges, creating new geometry along the way.

- Fill

Fills space along continuous edges, creating a new polygon.

- Flip

Flips a polygon so its surface is pointing in the opposite direction.

- Insert

Leftclick on an edge, drag along the edge and release the mousebutton to insert an edge-ring.

- Inset

Creates new geometry inside a polygon.

- Knife

Leftclick on an edge or vertex and doubleclick on another edge or vertex to insert and connect new vertices.

- Revolve

Create new geometry by rotating a single polygon along an edge and creating polygons along the way.

- Merge

Merge objects, polygons or uvs.

- Mirror

Create a copy of an object, mirroring it along an axis.

- Move

Move objects, polygons, edges, vertices or uv's by using the gizmo or by setting specific parameters.

- Optimize

Optimizes objects by automatically merging polygons and removing redundant vertices.

- Paint

Paints vertices in a specific colour. Needs lots of vertices. Use on subdivided objects such as grids. Does not work with textured objects.

- Rotate

Rotate objects, polygons, edges, vertices or uv's by using the gizmo or by setting specific parameters.

- Scale

Scale objects, polygons, edges, vertices or uv's by using the gizmo or by setting specific parameters.

- Sculpt

Sculpts objects by moving vertices. Needs lots of vertices. Use on subdivided objects such as grids.

- Smooth

Smooths objects, making them rounder. This will increase their number of polygons very much.

- Split

Splits edges into multiple edges.

- Triangulate

Create triangles out of polygons.

- UVMap

Generates UV coordinates using specific parameters.
